title: Missing media alternative (AAA)
user_impact: Users who cannot play video or audio receive no text alternative.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded) (AAA), G69, G159
checks.applicability: Every page (page-wide manual note, enriched when <video> / iframe embeds and a transcript link are found).
checks.expectation:
Always one UNTESTED note: on pages with video it names the video and, when a
nearby link mentions a transcript, quotes it as evidence (presence, not
completeness); without detected media it is the general 1.2.8 reminder. Never a
pass, never a violation.
checks.manual_reason:
Whether prerecorded media has a full text alternative or audio description is
a judgement about the content of the media; the DOM can only show that media
(or a transcript link) exists. The note stands on every page because custom
players are not reliably detectable.
